name: Translation 即时翻译
description: Translation 即时翻译 —— 多引擎翻译插件，内置 8 类引擎：OpenAI 兼容大模型（DeepSeek、通义、智谱、Kimi、Ollama、vLLM 等）、本地 CLI 代理（claude / codex / 自定义）、DeepL、Google、百度、有道、阿里云、腾讯云；含流式输出、输入即译、引擎管理与翻译历史。所有网络请求由内置 Go 侧车发出（浏览器沙箱的 CSP 禁止前端直连外部端点，且 host.network 白名单最多 8 个固定 origin，无法满足用户自填端点）；侧车会直连用户在引擎配置中填写的任意 HTTP/HTTPS 端点，翻译原文将发往用户所选引擎的第三方服务。本地 CLI 引擎以参数数组方式（不经 shell）执行用户配置的本机命令，凭据由该 CLI 自持，插件不接触。API Key 经系统密钥库（Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux secret-tool）加密后落盘到插件数据目录，不可用时降级为机器绑定 AES-256-GCM 并在界面明确警示。引擎配置、翻译历史与界面偏好统一存放在 <插件数据目录>/translation.db（SQLite），由侧车写入；其中翻译历史（原文与译文）为明文保存，卸载插件后仍会保留，可在「历史」页随时清空；前端运行在 opaque origin 沙箱中，不接触磁盘，也不使用 localStorage。
releaseNotes: 0.2.2：商店上架整改 —— 新增 Apache-2.0 LICENSE；发布产物改由 GitHub Actions 从 tag 用固定 Go 工具链（1.21.13）真机构建，sidecar 内嵌 vcs.revision 可在公开仓库核验；候选元数据改为 DBX Store 扁平 schema 并使用 release 资产绝对 HTTPS 地址；listing 补全 8 类引擎清单，并披露原文发往所选第三方服务、明文 SQLite 历史落盘、localcli 参数化执行本机命令。

en.name: Translation
en.description: Translation — multi-engine translation plugin with 8 engine types: OpenAI-compatible LLMs (DeepSeek, Qwen, Zhipu, Kimi, Ollama, vLLM, …), local CLI proxies (claude / codex / custom), DeepL, Google, Baidu, Youdao, Alibaba Cloud and Tencent Cloud; with streaming output, translate-as-you-type, engine management and translation history. All HTTP requests are issued by the bundled Go sidecar (the browser sandbox CSP forbids direct calls, and the host.network allowlist cannot express user-supplied endpoints); the sidecar connects directly to whatever HTTP/HTTPS endpoint the user configures per engine, and the source text is sent to the third-party service of the chosen engine. The local CLI engine executes user-configured local commands via an argument array (never through a shell); credentials stay with that CLI and are never touched by the plugin. API keys are encrypted with the OS keychain (Windows DPAPI / macOS Keychain / Linux secret-tool) before being written to the plugin data directory, falling back to machine-bound AES-256-GCM with an explicit in-UI warning. Engine config, history and preferences live in <plugin-data>/translation.db (SQLite), written by the sidecar; translation history (source and target text) is stored in plaintext and survives uninstallation, and can be cleared at any time from the History tab; the frontend runs in an opaque-origin sandbox and never touches disk or localStorage.
